---
name: create-go-etl
description: Create a reliable Go ETL or ingestion worker.
agent: etl-go
---

Create the requested Go ETL or ingestion worker. Determine source, target, schema/key, incremental behavior, expected volume, authentication, concurrency limits, and execution environment.

Inspect the repository first. Use contexts, bounded concurrency, streaming I/O, explicit error classification, idempotency, checkpoints, structured logs, tests, and repository-native configuration. Run formatting and configured checks.
